meta.title: Andrés I. Franco — Leadership, digital transformation and impact
meta.description: International executive and leader in digital transformation, artificial intelligence and intelligent automation. Vice President & Head of Latin America at SS&C Technologies / Blue Prism, leadership coach, speaker and co-founder of Sereniti Foundation.
meta.ogAlt: Andrés I. Franco — Leadership that transforms organisations, people and communities

hero.statement: Leadership that transforms organisations, people and communities.
hero.support: International executive, digital transformation leader, coach and speaker with more than three decades building businesses across multiple continents, developing leaders and creating impact today in Latin America.
hero.roleTitle: Vice President & Head of Latin America

intro.headline: More than 30 years building transformation.
intro.body1: An international career built at the intersection of technology, business strategy and human development. From scaling regional operations to developing leaders, the through-line has always been the same: organisations transform when the people who make them possible transform.
intro.body2: That work now runs on four fronts — the digital transformation of large enterprises, the development of leaders, the public conversation about technology and society, and social impact across Latin America — all answering to a single idea of leadership.
intro.statement: Technology transforms processes. Leadership transforms organisations.

transformation.lead: As Vice President and Head of Latin America at SS&C Technologies / Blue Prism, Andrés leads the regional strategy in intelligent automation, artificial intelligence and agentic AI, working alongside large organisations as they transform their operations.
transformation.body: His work connects the technology agenda to the business agenda: identifying where automation creates real value, building the teams that deliver it, and sustaining the change inside each organisation's culture.
transformation.subtitle: SS&C Technologies / Blue Prism · NASDAQ: SSNC
transformation.caption: WorkHQ Bootcamp — training on agentic workflows with teams and partners across the region.

leadership.headline: Developing leaders who develop organisations.
leadership.lead: With more than fifteen years as a certified coach in John Maxwell leadership methodologies, Andrés works with executives and teams on development processes that combine strategic rigour with personal growth.
leadership.body: The approach is that of a serving executive, not an outside observer: the same frameworks he applies while running regional operations are the ones he uses with directors, commercial teams and organisations in transformation.

speaker.headline: Ideas that move people and organisations.
speaker.lead: Andrés speaks and sits on panels at executive gatherings, industry forums and corporate programmes across Latin America, in front of audiences that range from technical teams to boards.
speaker.body: His talks translate complex subjects — artificial intelligence, automation, economics, leadership — into concrete decisions for the people who have to make them.

impact.headline: Leadership with purpose.
impact.lead: Andrés is a co-founder of Sereniti Foundation, a United States-based non-profit dedicated to strengthening the development of Latin American communities.
impact.body: The foundation connects donors with local organisations and concentrates its work on youth education, strategic partnerships and wellbeing programmes. It is the natural continuation of a commitment to community service sustained throughout his career.

recognition.title: Certificate of Special Congressional Recognition
recognition.body: Awarded to Andrés Franco and Jennifer Heegaard in recognition of their contribution to the Hispanic community and to initiatives in social impact, education and community development.

pulso.subtitle: Politics, economics and society through an open conversation about the forces shaping our time, held to the same discipline as the analysis of an organisation: data, context and consequences.
